label: Teardown Sheet
description: The viral museum-teardown treatment: a product presented as an annotated technical plate — exploded, cutaway or blueprint.
prefix: A museum-quality technical presentation of a product — dismantled and annotated like a precious specimen, engineering beauty as the entire message.
suffix: Technical Finish: (every screw, gasket and board rendered with catalog precision:1.25), shadowless even studio light on a seamless ground, strict grid order and centered symmetry, fine leader lines to elegant labels, consistent soft shadows anchoring each floating part.
negative: clutter, watermark, chaotic arrangement, missing parts
